svg.title: Global edge and hybrid transit topology
svg.desc: Topology showing global clients through Front Door, two datacenters through dual ExpressRoute and VPN backup, Virtual WAN transit, private DNS, and monitoring.

g.aria-label: accelerated public application path: front-door to virtual-wan
primary private connectivity: datacenters to expressroute
encrypted failover connectivity: datacenters to vpn
private circuit transit: expressroute to virtual-wan
backup transit path: vpn to virtual-wan
hybrid name resolution: virtual-wan to dns
reachability and capacity telemetry: virtual-wan to performance
Service node: Capacity and latency signals

svg.text: Front Door accelerates internet entry while dual ExpressRoute circuits, VPN failover, and Virtual WAN provide governed hybrid transit.
